chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn ʿUthman, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Aba ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام about a man who prayed one rakʿah of the dawn prayer, then turned away and went out for his needs, then remembered that he had prayed only one rakʿah. He said: Let him complete what remains.

key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: the dawn prayer, meaning salat al-fajr
key_terms.انْصَرَفَ: he turned away or departed after prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he remembers after leaving that he prayed only one rakʿah of salat al-ghadah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performed only one rakʿah of the dawn salat and then left before realizing the deficiency. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rules that he should complete the remaining part of the prayer, indicating the continuity of the obligation when the omission is remembered.
